text.body: ||śrīḥ|| ||praśnottararatnamālikā|| kaḥ khalu nālaṃkriyate dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthasādhanapaṭīyān| amuyā kaṇṭhasthitayā praśnottararatnamālikayā|| 1|| bhagavankimupādeyaṃ guruvacanaṃ heyamapi ca kimakāryam| ko gururadhigatatattvaḥ śiṣyahitāyodyataḥ satatam|| 2|| tvaritaṃ kiṃ kartavyaṃ viduṣāṃ saṃsārasaṃtaticchedaḥ| kiṃ mokṣatarorbījaṃ samyakjñānaṃ kriyāsiddham|| 3|| kaḥ pathyataro dharmaḥ kaḥ śuciriha yasya mānasaṃ śuddham| kaḥ paṇḍito vivekī kiṃ viṣamavadhīraṇā guruṣu|| 4|| kiṃ saṃsāre sāraṃ bahuśo'pi vicintyamānamidameva| kiṃ manujeṣviṣṭatamaṃ svaparahitāyodyataṃ janma|| 5|| madireva mohajanakaḥ kaḥ snehaḥ ke ca dasyavo viṣayāḥ| kā bhavavallī tṛṣṇā ko vairī yastvanudyogaḥ|| 6|| kasmādbhayamiha maraṇādandhādiha ko viśiṣyate rāgī| kaḥ śūro yo lalanālocanabāṇairna ca vyadhitaḥ|| 7|| pātuṃ karṇāñjalibhiḥ kimamṛtamiha yujyate sadupadeśaḥ| kiṃ gurutāyā mūlaṃ yadetadaprārthanaṃ nāma|| 8|| kiṃ gahanaṃ strīcaritaṃ kaścaturo yo na khaṇḍitastena| kiṃ duḥkhamasaṃtoṣaḥ kiṃ lāghavamadhamato yācñā|| 9|| kiṃ jīvitamanavadyaṃ kiṃ jāḍyaṃ pāṭhato'pyanabhyāsaḥ| ko jāgarti vivekī kā nidrā mūḍhatā jantoḥ|| 10|| nalinīdalagatajalavattaralaṃ kiṃ yauvanaṃ dhanaṃ cāyuḥ| kathaya punaḥ ke śaśinaḥ kiraṇasamāḥ sajjanā eva|| 11|| ko narakaḥ paravaśatā kiṃ saukhyaṃ sarvasaṅgaviratiryā| kiṃ satyaṃ bhūtahitaṃ priyaṃ ca kiṃ prāṇināmasavaḥ|| 12|| ko'narthaphalo mānaḥ kā sukhadā sādhujanamaitrī| sarvavyasanavināśe ko dakṣaḥ sarvathā tyāgī|| 13|| kiṃ maraṇaṃ mūrkhatvaṃ kiṃ cānarghaṃ yadavasare dattam| āmaraṇāÏtka śalyaṃ pracchannaṃ yatkṛtaṃ pāpam|| 14|| kutra vidheyo yatno vidyābhyāse sadauṣadhe dāne| avadhīraṇā kva kāryā khalaparayoṣitparadhaneṣu|| 15|| kāharniśamanucintyā saṃsārāsāratā na tu pramadā| kā preyasī vidheyā karuṇā dīneṣu sajjane maitrī|| 16|| kaṇṭhagatairapyasubhiḥ kasya hrātmā na śakyate jetum| mūrkhasya śaṅkitasya ca viṣādino vā kṛtaghnasya|| 17|| kaḥ sādhuḥ sadvṛttaḥ kamadhamamācakṣate tvasadvṛttam| kena jitaṃ jagadetatsatyatitikṣāvatā puṃsā|| 18|| kasmai namāṃsi devāḥ kurvanti dayāpradhānāya| kasmādudvegaḥ syātsaṃsārāraṇyataḥ sudhiyaḥ|| 19|| kasya vaśe prāṇigaṇaḥ satyapriyabhāṣiṇo vinītasya| kva sthātavyaṃ nyāyye pathi dṛṣṭādṛṣṭalābhāya|| 20|| ko'ndho yo'kāryarataḥ ko badhiro yo hitāni na śrṛṇoti| ko mūko yaḥ kāle priyāṇi vaktuṃ na jānāti|| 21|| kiṃ dānamanākāṅkṣaṃ kiṃ mitraṃ yo nivārayati pāpāt| ko'laṃkāraḥ śīlaṃ kiṃ vācāṃ maṇḍanaṃ satyam|| 22|| vidyudvilasitacapalaṃ kiṃ durjanasaṃgatiryuvatayaśca| kulaśīlaniṣprakampāḥ ke kalikāle'pi sajjanā eva|| 23|| cintāmaṇiriva durlabhamiha kiṃ kathayāmi taccaturbhadram| kiṃ tadvadanti bhūyo vidhūtatamasā viśeṣeṇa|| 24|| dānaṃ priyavāksahitaṃ jñānamagarva kṣamānvitaṃ śauryam| vittaṃ tyāgasametaṃ durlabhametaccaturbhadram|| 25|| kiṃ śocyaṃ kārpaṇyaṃ sati vibhave kiṃ praśastamaudāryam| kaḥ pūjyo vidvadbhiḥ svabhāvataḥ sarvadā vinīto yaḥ|| 26|| kaḥ kulakamaladineśaḥ sati guṇavibhave'pi yo namraḥ| kasya vaśe jagadetatpriyahitavacanasya dharmaniratasya|| 27|| vidvanmanoharā kā satkavitā bodhavanitā ca| kaṃ na spṛśati vipattiḥ pravṛddhavacanānuvartinaṃ dāntam|| 28|| kasmai spṛhayati kamalā tvanalasacittāya nītivṛttāya| tyajati ca kaṃ sahasā dvijagurusuranindākaraṃ ca sālasyam|| 29|| kutra vidheyo vāsaḥ sajjananikaṭe'thavā kāśyām| kaḥ parihāryo deśaḥ piśunayuto lubdhabhūpaśca|| 30|| kenāśocyaḥ puruṣaḥ praṇatakalatreṇa dhīravibhavena| iha bhuvane kaḥ śocyaḥ satyapi vibhave na yo dātā|| 31|| kiṃ laghutāyā mūlaṃ prākṛtapuruṣeṣu yā yācñā| rāmādapi kaḥ śūraḥ smaraśaranihato na yaścalati|| 32|| kimaharniśamanucintyaṃ bhagavaccaraṇaṃ na saṃsāraḥ| cakṣuṣmanto'pyandhāḥ ke syurye nāstikā manujāḥ|| 33|| kaḥ paṅguriha prathito vrajati ca yo vārdhake tīrtham| kiṃ tīrthamapi ca mukhyaṃ cittamalaṃ yannivartayati|| 34|| kiṃ smartavyaṃ puruṣairharināma sadā na yāvanī bhāṣā| ko hi na vācyaḥ sudhiyā paradoṣaścānṛtaṃ tadvat|| 35|| kiṃ saṃpādyaṃ manujairvidyā vittaṃ balaṃ yaśaḥ puṇyam| kaḥ sarvaguṇavināśī lobhaḥ śatruśca kaḥ kāmaḥ|| 36|| kā ca sabhā parihāryā hīnā yā vṛddhasacivena| iha kutrāvahitaḥ syānmanujaḥ kila rājasevāyām|| 37|| prāṇādapi ko ramyaḥ kuladharmaḥ sādhusaṅgaśca| kā saṃrakṣyā kīrtiḥ pativratā naijabuddhiśca|| 38|| kā kalpalatā loke sacchiṣyāyārpitā vidyā| ko'kṣayavaṭavṛkṣaḥ syādvidhivatsatpātradattadānaṃ yat|| 39|| kiṃ śastraṃ sarveṣāṃ yuktirmātā ca kā dhenuḥ| kiṃ nu balaṃ yaddhairyaṃ ko mṛtyuryadavadhānarahitatvam|| 40|| kutra viṣaṃ duṣṭajane kimihāśaucaṃ bhavedṛṇaṃ naṇām| kimabhayamiha vairāgyaṃ bhayamapi kiṃ vittameva sarveṣām|| 41|| kā durlabhā narāṇāṃ haribhaktiḥ pātakaṃ ca kiṃ hiṃsā| ko hi bhagavatpriyaḥ syādyo'nyaṃ nodvejayedanudvignaḥ|| 42|| kasmātsiddhistapaso buddhiḥ kva nu bhūsure kuto buddhiḥ| vṛddhopasevayā ke vṛddhā ye dharmatattvajñāḥ|| 43|| saṃbhāvitasya maraṇādadhikaṃ kiṃ duryaśo bhavati| loke sukhī bhavetko dhanavāndhanamapi ca kiṃ yataśceṣṭam|| 44|| sarvasukhānāṃ bījaṃ kiṃ puṇyaṃ duḥkhamapi kutaḥ pāpāt| kasyaiśvaryaṃ yaḥ kila śaṃkaramārādhayedbhaktyā|| 45|| ko vardhate vinītaḥ ko vā hīyeta yo dṛptaḥ| ko na pratyetavyo brāūte yaścānṛtaṃ śaśvat|| 46|| kutrānṛte'pyapāpaṃ yaccoktaṃ dharmarakṣārtham| ko dharmo'bhimato yaḥ śiṣṭānāṃ nijakulīnānām|| 47|| sādhubalaṃ kiṃ daivaṃ kaḥ sādhuḥ sarvadā tuṣṭaḥ| daivaṃ kiṃ yatsukṛtaṃ kaḥ sukṛtī ślāghyate ca yaḥ sadbhiḥ|| 48|| gṛhamedhinaśca mitraṃ kiṃ bhāryā ko gṛhī ca yo yajate| ko yajño yaḥ śrutyā vihitaḥ śreyaskaro nṝṇām|| 49|| kasya kriyā hi saphalā yaḥ punarācāravāñśiṣṭaḥ| kaḥ śiṣṭo yo vedapramāṇavānko hataḥ kriyābhraṣṭaḥ|| 50|| ko dhanyaḥ saṃnyāsī ko mānyaḥ paṇḍitaḥ sādhuḥ| kaḥ sevyo yo dātā ko dātā yo'rthitṛptimātanute|| 51|| kiṃ bhāgyaṃ dehavatāmārogyaṃ kaḥ phalī kṛṣikṛt| kasya na pāpaṃ japataḥ kaḥ pūrṇo yaḥ prajāvānsyāt|| 52|| kiṃ duṣkaraṃ narāṇāṃ yanmanaso nigrahaḥ satatam| ko brāhṛcaryavānsyādyaścāskhalitodhrvaretaskaḥ|| 53|| kā ca paradevatoktā cicchaktiḥ ko jagatbhartā| sūryaḥ sarveṣāṃ ko jīvanahetuḥ sa parjanyaḥ|| 54|| kaḥ śūro yo bhītatrātā trātā ca kaḥ sa guruḥ| ko hi jagadgururuktaḥ śaṃbhujrñānaṃ kutaḥ śivādeva|| 55|| mukiṃta labheta kasmādmukundabhaktermukundaḥ kaḥ| yastārayedavidyāṃ kā cāvidyā yadātmano'sphūrtiḥ|| 56|| kasya na śoko yaḥ syādakrodhaḥ kiṃ sukhaṃ tuṣṭiḥ| ko rājā rañjanakṛtkaśca śvā nīcasevako yaḥ syāt|| 57|| ko māyī parameśaḥ ka indrajālāyate prapañco'yam| kaḥ svapnanibho jāgradvyavahāraḥ satyamapi ca kiṃ brāhṛ|| 58|| kiṃ mithyā yadvidyānāśyaṃ tucchaṃ tu śaśaviṣāṇādi| kā cānirvacanīyā māyā kiṃ kalpitaṃ dvaitam|| 59|| kiṃ pāramārthikaṃ syādadvaitaṃ cājñatā kuto'nādiḥ| vapuṣaśca poṣakaṃ kiṃ prārabdhaṃ cānnadāyi kiṃ cāyuḥ|| 60|| ko brāāhṛṇairupāsyo gāyatryarkāgnigocaraḥ śaṃbhuḥ| gāyatryāmāditye cāgnau śaṃbhau ca kiṃ nu tattattvam|| 61|| pratyakṣadevatā kā mātā pūjyo guruśca kastātaḥ| kaḥ sarvadevatātmā vidyākarmānvito vipraḥ|| 62|| kaśca kulakṣayahetuḥ saṃtāpaḥ sajjaneṣu yo'kāri| keṣāmamoghavacanaṃ ye ca punaḥ satyamaunaśamaśīlāḥ|| 63|| kiṃ janma viṣayasaṅgaḥ kimuttaraṃ janma putraḥ syāt| ko'parihāryo mṛtyuḥ kutra padaṃ vinyasecca dṛkpūte|| 64|| pātraṃ kimannadāne kṣudhitaṃ ko'cryo hi bhagavadavatāraḥ| kaśca bhagavānmaheśaḥ śaṃkaranārāyaṇātmaikaḥ|| 65|| phalamapi bhagavadbhakteḥ kiṃ tallokasvarūpasākṣāttvam| mokṣaśca ko hravidyāstamayaḥ kaḥ sarvavedabhūratha com|| 66|| ityeṣā kaṇṭhasthā praśnottararatnamālikā yeṣām| te muktābharaṇā iva vimalāścābhānti satsamājeṣu|| 67|| iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya śrīmacchaṃkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau praśnottararatnamālikā saṃpūrṇā||
